title: The hub
notes: The ski-area hub open on a live resort with the piste map on, normal game camera, UI visible. State: a time jump to 07:32, then the sim at speed 8 to 14:04 (71 guests at 13:44, about 77 in the takes). The hub button is the second top-left button (click 152, 60). The piste map is the check box at the top of the hub's Runs view (opened with the Runs open tile, 3125, 300); it stays on after a switch to the Attraction view (tile 2986, 300), which shows guests, runs open, lifts and finances. Do not use photoMode.setOverlayHidden or the bridge's overlay op here: both hide the piste map. Icons: the six 'Powerline Not Connected - Low' icons on the three lift bases in frame (owners: the Summit Express, Ridge Express and Bowl Gondola base stations) got Game.Common.Deleted in one batch with the sim paused, then 60 frames and a status check; no other icon was touched. Hidden in the page before the take (style visibility): the third-party toolbar buttons (top-left row, client x 195 to 1215), the game's top info strip (the horizontal panel from x 1220) and the round buttons at the right edge (x over 3700, y 1450 to 1900). The cursor rests on an empty part of the panel (3400, 1300); OBS cursor capture is off. Sim speed 3 during the take so guests and money tick. Camera: east up the slope over the lift bases, the runs in their colors climbing beside the panel, a 5 degree orbit. Measured: tilt 25 to 27 is about 29 to 31 degrees below the horizon at the pivot, but the slope rises toward the camera's view, so the recorded frame reads nearly top-down at any tilt from 25 to 45; tilt 15 is clamped to 22. The recorded frame is also wider than a photo still from the same camera. Take 4 (best): zoom 420, the bases larger. Take 3: zoom 600, pivot (3265, -2450). Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60), rec.mjs dedupe.
